author: jsign
content:
New zkEVM benchmark release: [tests-zkevm-benchmark@v21.0.7](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm-benchmark%40v21.0.7). 
It's built from tests-zkevm@v21.0.7 above, with the same gas values as before: 30M, 60M, 100M, 150M and 200M. It has some extra benchmarks, but it's mostly needed because tests-zkevm@v21.0.7 changed `statelessOutputBytes`, so outputs from the previous benchmark release won't match.
